correctness.rationale: Definition 4.2 adds exactly the same excess-difference correction to every positive-grade coordinate of a fixed factor, so within-factor grade gaps are invariants. Theorem 4.4 then yields the exact lower-grade limits. Subtracting the PCOMR equations at grade k and at the top grade produces the stated compatibility condition. The packaged exact-rational checker verifies a smallest two-factor PCOMR fixed point distinct from the EAIE and an independent nonstationary invariant example.

value.rationale: Theorem 4.5 is the source's central full-vector convergence claim for its iterative EAIE implementation. The failure is structural: lower-grade offsets are conserved, so the algorithm can stop immediately at a non-EAIE fixed point even from a PCOMR initialization. The exact necessary-and-sufficient offset condition and its PCOMR specialization provide a sharp repair boundary, making this more than a one-off counterexample or routine arithmetic correction.
